{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-23T09:48:32.555086Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-23T09:48:32.554964Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-23T09:48:32.937708Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-23T09:48:32.937388Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-23T09:48:32.948011Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-23T09:48:32.947813Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-23T09:48:34.974675Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-23T09:48:34.969250Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-23T09:48:34.984081Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-23T09:48:34.983859Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-23T09:48:34.994666Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-23T09:48:34.989229Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-23T09:48:34.998955Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-23T09:48:34.998838Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.017505Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.017166Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.980\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.979\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     766.1\n",
      "Date:                Mon, 23 Nov 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           2.95e-39\n",
      "Time:                        09:48:35   Log-Likelihood:                -3.2226\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                             14.45\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                             22.09\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          4.9522      0.092     53.998      0.000       4.768       5.137\n",
      "x1             0.4994      0.014     35.311      0.000       0.471       0.528\n",
      "x2             0.4996      0.056      8.986      0.000       0.388       0.612\n",
      "x3            -0.0204      0.001    -16.400      0.000      -0.023      -0.018\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        1.063   Durbin-Watson:                   1.937\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.588   Jarque-Bera (JB):                0.400\n",
      "Skew:                          -0.122   Prob(JB):                        0.819\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       3.364   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.020936Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.020816Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.026542Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.026301Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.44300364  4.92489798  5.36742493  5.74335603  6.03528948  6.23850911\n",
      "  6.36175927  6.42580817  6.46003569  6.4976064   6.57002065  6.7019392\n",
      "  6.90713149  7.18621342  7.52654608  7.90431236  8.28842997  8.64565824\n",
      "  8.94605939  9.16791729  9.30130534  9.34971735  9.32949356  9.26713596\n",
      "  9.19495409  9.1457567   9.14746131  9.21850751  9.36482732  9.57887064\n",
      "  9.84084564 10.12197058 10.3892025  10.61066611 10.76089085 10.82499555\n",
      " 10.80113343 10.70079549 10.54692259 10.37013632 10.20370795 10.07809206\n",
      " 10.01592298 10.02829596 10.1129443  10.25461176 10.42755911 10.59979299\n",
      " 10.73832238 10.81457888]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.028895Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.028779Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.032952Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.032669Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[10.79562038 10.64454403 10.38094273 10.04946622  9.70888926  9.41772156\n",
      "  9.21988248  9.13394813  9.14860322  9.22541149]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.035891Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.035779Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.356868Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.356324Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x7411b0a27230>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.359991Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.359852Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.373252Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.372667Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.374622Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.374195Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.387038Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.386667Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           4.952161\n",
       "x1                  0.499436\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.499612\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.020366\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.388277Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.388157Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.397329Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-23T09:48:35.396680Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    10.795620\n",
       "1    10.644544\n",
       "2    10.380943\n",
       "3    10.049466\n",
       "4     9.708889\n",
       "5     9.417722\n",
       "6     9.219882\n",
       "7     9.133948\n",
       "8     9.148603\n",
       "9     9.225411\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
